color.semantic: Monochrome mappings; success, warning, danger are visually weak and insufficiently differentiated

typography.display_character: Oversized, tightly tracked, heavy editorial sans
typography.body_character: Neutral system sans with generous line height
typography.issue: Display scale is expressive but generic; body and interface typography lack a distinctive professional-healthcare voice

spacing.density: Spacious on homepage, medium on supporting pages
spacing.issue: Homepage and site-page systems use separate rhythm rules

layout.supporting_pages: Generic hero, summary, card, list, and split layouts
layout.issue: Two parallel visual systems create inconsistent hierarchy and component character

shape.issue: Rounded portrait and pill buttons conflict with otherwise sharp editorial composition

elevation.depth_strategy: Borders, tone changes, and occasional backdrop blur

design_style.composition: Large typography, broad whitespace, bordered grids, black closing sections
design_style.imagery: Mostly monochrome; portrait treatment exists but is not consistently integrated
weaknesses: Homepage and internal pages feel designed by different systems
Some content modules are visually dense

visual_effects.assessment: Appropriately restrained; no heavy visual effect is currently justified
